# BStudioB

BStudioB Ltd is an independent UK software studio. It creates focused product previews and offers scoped advisory and implementation services for workflow digitisation, company-system configuration, automation and bespoke internal tools.

Canonical website: https://bstudiob.co.uk/
Contact: mailto:hello@bstudiob.co.uk

## Services

- Custom Workflow Solutions: https://bstudiob.co.uk/services.html
  Advisory and implementation work is subject to scope. Outcomes depend on context and implementation; no guaranteed savings are claimed.

## Products and previews

- Tributary (formerly FlowCue): https://bstudiob.co.uk/tributary/
  Invite-only local-network desktop presentation and show-control software for church services, business meetings and live performances. A host saves mode-specific shows, synchronises lyrics, bundled KJV passages, supported PDF/PowerPoint imports, media and performer cues with browser-based receiver screens, and can provide a camera background and OBS browser-source outputs. Church shows can group still images into timed slideshows. Beta access and installers are supplied manually; builds are unsigned and platform availability is confirmed per invite while real-device validation continues. There is no public self-service account, subscription checkout or automatic update/install flow.
- Buildy: https://bstudiob.co.uk/studio-tools.html
  Private-beta web-publishing workspace; access is by invitation.
- Inspector-Edu: https://bstudiob.co.uk/trust-security.html
  Supervised, authorised institutional security-education pilot only.
- Cards: https://bstudiob.co.uk/cards.html
  Early playtest concept; no public production availability is implied.
- PIT, the public name of PicChat: https://bstudiob.co.uk/products/pit/
  Internal beta and development preview; MyMark integration remains under qualification.
- Provisioning: https://provisioning.bstudiob.co.uk/
  Independently hosted staging application, not a production service.
